# Purpose

This script takes the raw Qualtrics export and produces three files that the
analysis script reads directly.

* `data_clean_person.rds` — one row per respondent, all person-level variables
  including standardised predictors.
* `data_clean_long.rds` — one row per person × action (18 actions), with the
  three-state classification, ratings, roles, and person-level predictors
  merged in.
* `data_rudersdal_anon.csv` — anonymised raw for sharing.

```{r packages}
required_pkgs <- c(
  "tidyverse", "here", "janitor", "labelled", "psych", "conflicted"
)
to_install <- setdiff(required_pkgs, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(to_install) > 0) install.packages(to_install)
invisible(lapply(required_pkgs, library, character.only = TRUE))

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(
  dplyr::filter, dplyr::select, dplyr::mutate,
  dplyr::summarise, dplyr::arrange, dplyr::lag, dplyr::recode
)

set.seed(20260305)
```

# Read and screen

```{r read}
here::i_am("data_cleaning.Rmd")
df_raw <- readr::read_delim(here::here("data/data_rudersdal_new.csv"),
                          col_types = cols()) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  readr::type_convert()

nrow(df_raw)
```

```{r screen}
qualtrics_vars <- c(
  "ip_address", "recipient_last_name", "recipient_first_name",
  "recipient_email", "external_reference", "location_latitude",
  "location_longitude", "distribution_channel", "user_language", "status"
)

df <- df_raw |>
  select(-any_of(qualtrics_vars)) |>
  filter(
    consent == 1,
    finished == 1
  )

# Duplicates
dupes <- df |> count(response_id) |> filter(n > 1)
stopifnot(nrow(dupes) == 0)

# Completion. Report rather than filter; if you exclude speeders, do it here
# and record how many, because the Methods needs the number.
summary(df$duration_in_seconds)
median_time <- median(df$duration_in_seconds, na.rm = TRUE)
n_speeders  <- sum(df$duration_in_seconds < median_time / 3, na.rm = TRUE)
message("Completed in under one third of median time: ", n_speeders)

# Termination flag from the survey flow
if ("q_terminate_flag" %in% names(df)) print(table(df$q_terminate_flag, useNA = "ifany"))

nrow(df)
```

## Response rate and non-response

```{r response-rate}
n_invited  <- 10000
n_complete <- nrow(df)

tibble(
  invited        = n_invited,
  complete       = n_complete,
  response_rate  = round(100 * n_complete / n_invited, 1)
)

# Sample composition for comparison against municipal register statistics
df |>
  summarise(
    mean_age     = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_age       = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_female   = 100 * mean(gender == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_income_cat = median(income, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## Anonymised export

```{r anon}
# The public-use file excludes direct identifiers, exact timestamps, Qualtrics
# identifiers/metadata, linkage/contact variables, and all free-text responses.
# A fresh study ID replaces response_id, and rows are shuffled so file order
# cannot be used as a proxy for survey completion time.
sensitive_vars <- c(
  "response_id", "start_date", "end_date", "recorded_date",
  "duration_in_seconds", "progress", "finished", "consent",
  "consent_register", "interview", "contact", "contact_id", "id",
  "q_terminate_flag", "personal_action", "occupation_8_text",
  "mun_suggestions", "mail", "telephone"
)

set.seed(20260305)
df_anon <- df |>
  mutate(study_id = sprintf("P%04d", sample.int(n()))) |>
  select(-any_of(sensitive_vars)) |>
  relocate(study_id) |>
  slice_sample(prop = 1)

readr::write_csv(df_anon, here::here("data", "data_rudersdal_anon.csv"))

stopifnot(
  !any(sensitive_vars %in% names(df_anon)),
  n_distinct(df_anon$study_id) == nrow(df_anon)
)

# Register-consent subset, kept separately if needed later
df_register <- df |> filter(consent_register == 1)
message("Consented to register linkage: ", nrow(df_register))
```

# Classify the 18 climate actions

The raw opportunity items code 1–5 as the certainty rating, 6 as "I do or have
already done this", and "Not relevant for me" as either 7 or a blank depending
on the export. We check which, then build one three-state variable per action
rather than the previous PEB / opportunity_na pair.

```{r classify}
opp_raw <- c(paste0("opportunity_consumer_", 1:9),
             paste0("opportunity_other_", 1:9))
mot_raw <- c(paste0("motivation_consumer_", 1:9),
             paste0("motivation_other_", 1:9))
wb_raw  <- c(paste0("wellbeing_consumer_", 1:9),
             paste0("wellbeing_other_", 1:9))

stopifnot(all(c(opp_raw, mot_raw, wb_raw) %in% names(df)))

# Diagnostic: is "not relevant" exported as 7, or as a blank?
n_sevens <- sum(map_int(df[opp_raw], ~sum(.x == 7, na.rm = TRUE)))
message("Responses coded 7: ", n_sevens,
        if (n_sevens == 0) "  -> blanks are being treated as 'not relevant'" else "")

# Renumber to 1:18 in the order used throughout the paper
names(df)[match(opp_raw, names(df))] <- paste0("opportunity_", 1:18)
names(df)[match(mot_raw, names(df))] <- paste0("motivation_",  1:18)
names(df)[match(wb_raw,  names(df))] <- paste0("wellbeing_",   1:18)

for (i in 1:18) {
  o <- df[[paste0("opportunity_", i)]]

  df[[paste0("action_status_", i)]] <- dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(o) | o == 7 ~ "Not relevant",
    o == 6            ~ "Already taken",
    o %in% 1:5        ~ "Relevant, not taken",
    TRUE              ~ NA_character_
  )

  # Perceived opportunity to act: only defined for relevant, not-yet-taken
  df[[paste0("opportunity_", i)]] <- ifelse(o %in% 1:5, o, NA_real_)
}

```

# Behavioural baselines

## Air travel

Aggregation follows Pizzo et al., with one adjustment. Their item asks about
round trips and applies round-trip distances of 2,000 / 5,800 / 11,500 km. The
Rudersdal item asks about one-way legs and says so explicitly (Copenhagen–Madrid
return counts as two trips), so the per-leg distances are half of theirs.

```{r flying}
haul_km <- c(short = 1000, medium = 2900, long = 5750)   # per one-way leg

all_flying_blank <- is.na(df$flying_1) & is.na(df$flying_2) & is.na(df$flying_3)
message("Left all three flying items blank: ", sum(all_flying_blank))

df <- df |>
  mutate(
    # Partial blanks are treated as zero; respondents who skipped all three are
    # treated as missing, since coding non-response as zero would bias the
    # distribution downward in exactly the group least likely to fly.
    f1 = replace_na(flying_1, 0),
    f2 = replace_na(flying_2, 0),
    f3 = replace_na(flying_3, 0),

    flying_frequency = f1 + f2 + f3,
    flying_distance  = f1 * haul_km["short"] +
                       f2 * haul_km["medium"] +
                       f3 * haul_km["long"],

    flying_frequency = ifelse(all_flying_blank, NA_real_, flying_frequency),
    flying_distance  = ifelse(all_flying_blank, NA_real_, flying_distance)
  ) |>
  select(-f1, -f2, -f3)

# Non-flyers plus tertiles among flyers (skewed and zero-inflated)
cuts <- quantile(df$flying_distance[df$flying_distance > 0],
                 c(1/3, 2/3), na.rm = TRUE)

df <- df |>
  mutate(
    flying_distance_cat = case_when(
      is.na(flying_distance)     ~ NA_character_,
      flying_distance == 0       ~ "Non-flyer",
      flying_distance <= cuts[1] ~ "Low",
      flying_distance <= cuts[2] ~ "Medium",
      TRUE                       ~ "High"
    ) |> factor(levels = c("Non-flyer", "Low", "Medium", "High"))
  )

df |> count(flying_distance_cat)
df |> group_by(flying_distance_cat) |>
  summarise(mean_km = mean(flying_distance), n = n())
```

## Driving, diet, clothing


```{r other-baselines}
df <- df |> mutate(red_meat = meat_1, white_meat = meat_2)
```

# Composite scales

```{r composites}
row_mean_min <- function(data, vars, min_valid) {
  m <- as.matrix(data[vars])
  n_valid <- rowSums(!is.na(m))
  out <- rowMeans(m, na.rm = TRUE)
  out[n_valid < min_valid] <- NA_real_
  out
}

# Climate conversation. Response 8 = "not relevant" -> missing.
# psych::alpha() can silently reverse-key an item that correlates negatively
# with the total, so we compute alpha with check.keys = FALSE and print the
# item statistics to confirm no item needs reversing.
alpha_raw <- function(data, vars) {
  a <- psych::alpha(data[vars], check.keys = FALSE, warnings = FALSE)
  print(round(a$item.stats[, c("r.drop", "mean", "sd")], 2))
  a$total$raw_alpha
}

conv_vars <- paste0("conversation_", 1:4)
df[conv_vars] <- lapply(df[conv_vars], function(x) ifelse(x == 8, NA, x))
alpha_conversation <- alpha_raw(df, conv_vars)
df$conversation <- row_mean_min(df, conv_vars, min_valid = 2)

# Individual-attribution belief (previously "autonomy"): attribution of
# inaction to individual willpower rather than to structural constraint.
attr_vars <- paste0("autonomy_", 1:3)
alpha_attribution <- alpha_raw(df, attr_vars)
df$attribution <- row_mean_min(df, attr_vars, min_valid = 2)
alpha_attribution

# Techno-optimism
tech_vars <- paste0("techno_optimism_", 1:3)
alpha_techno <- alpha_raw(df, tech_vars)
df$techno_optimism <- row_mean_min(df, tech_vars, min_valid = 2)

# Political orientation: economic and social/values only.
# political_3 is climate and environmental policy and is kept separate.
df$political         <- row_mean_min(df, c("political_1", "political_2"), min_valid = 1)
df$political_climate <- df$political_3

tibble(
  scale = c("conversation", "attribution", "techno_optimism"),
  alpha = round(c(alpha_conversation, alpha_attribution, alpha_techno), 2)
)
```

# Demographics and socioeconomic position

```{r demographics}
df <- df |>
  mutate(
    income      = ifelse(income == 11, NA, income),        # prefer not to say
    leadership  = ifelse(leadership == 4, NA, leadership), # prefer not to say

    gender_bin  = ifelse(gender %in% c(1, 2), gender - 1, NA),  # 0 = man, 1 = woman

    is_employed = factor(
      case_when(
        is.na(occupation)             ~ NA_character_,
        occupation %in% c(1, 2, 3)    ~ "Employed",
        TRUE                          ~ "Not employed"
      ),
      levels = c("Not employed", "Employed")
    ),

    # Leadership was only asked of full- and part-time employees, so
    # self-employed respondents are missing by design. We retain them as a
    # separate descriptive category; leadership models exclude them because
    # their responsibility level was not measured.
    leadership_cat = case_when(
      occupation == 3        ~ "Self-employed",
      leadership == 1        ~ "Strategic/financial",
      leadership == 2        ~ "Professional/administrative",
      leadership == 3        ~ "No decision authority",
      TRUE                   ~ NA_character_
    ) |> factor(levels = c("No decision authority",
                           "Professional/administrative",
                           "Strategic/financial",
                           "Self-employed"))
  )

df |> count(occupation, leadership_cat)
```

# Standardised predictors

```{r z-scores}
z <- function(x) as.numeric(scale(x))

df <- df |>
  mutate(
    age_z                 = z(age),
    income_z              = z(income),
    income_status         = if_else(is.na(income_z), "missing", "reported"),
    income_filled_z       = if_else(is.na(income_z), 0, income_z),

    occupation_prestige_z = z(occupation_prestige),
    prestige_status       = if_else(is.na(occupation_prestige_z), "missing", "reported"),
    prestige_filled_z     = if_else(is.na(occupation_prestige_z), 0, occupation_prestige_z),

    political_z           = z(political),
    action_knowledge_z    = z(action_knowledge),
    climate_knowledge_z   = z(climate_knowledge),
    conversation_z        = z(conversation),
    attribution_z         = z(attribution),
    techno_optimism_z     = z(techno_optimism),
    injunctive_norm_z     = z(injunctive_norm),
    climate_impact_z      = z(cc_impact),
    carbon_footprint_z    = z(carbon_footprint)
  )
```

# Person-level file

```{r person-file}
status_vars <- paste0("action_status_", 1:18)

df_person <- df |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    n_not_relevant    = sum(c_across(all_of(status_vars)) == "Not relevant"),
    n_already_taken   = sum(c_across(all_of(status_vars)) == "Already taken"),
    opportunity_space = 18 - n_not_relevant,
    remaining_space   = opportunity_space - n_already_taken,
    utilisation_share = ifelse(opportunity_space > 0,
                               n_already_taken / opportunity_space, NA_real_)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

df_person |>
  summarise(across(c(opportunity_space, n_already_taken, remaining_space),
                   list(mean = mean, median = median), .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"))

# Respondents who classified all 18 actions as not relevant
df_person |> filter(opportunity_space == 0) |> nrow()
```

# Long file

```{r long-file}
behaviour_labels <- c(
  "1"  = "Buy an electric car",
  "2"  = "Improve home energy efficiency",
  "3"  = "Take fewer flights",
  "4"  = "Eat less red meat",
  "5"  = "Use public transport for most longer trips",
  "6"  = "Install solar panels",
  "7"  = "Eat less white meat",
  "8"  = "Drive fewer kilometers",
  "9"  = "Reduce home heating/cooling energy use",
  "10" = "Move investments/pension to climate-friendly funds",
  "11" = "Donate to climate organizations",
  "12" = "Suggest or support climate initiatives at work",
  "13" = "Promote ambitious climate-related changes in organization",
  "14" = "Be a climate role model",
  "15" = "Talk with family/friends about climate action",
  "16" = "Vote for pro-climate politicians",
  "17" = "Sign petitions/contact politicians about climate",
  "18" = "Participate in climate demonstrations"
)

role_levels <- c("Consumer (technology)", "Consumer (curtailment)",
                 "Organisational participant", "Investor", "Citizen",
                 "Social role model")

person_vars <- c(
  "response_id", "age", "age_z", "gender_bin", "is_employed",
  "income", "income_z", "income_status", "income_filled_z",
  "occupation", "occupation_prestige_z", "prestige_status", "prestige_filled_z",
  "leadership_cat", "political_z", "political_climate",
  "action_knowledge_z", "climate_knowledge_z", "conversation_z",
  "attribution_z", "techno_optimism_z", "injunctive_norm_z",
  "climate_impact_z", "carbon_footprint_z",
  "driving", "flying_frequency", "flying_distance", "flying_distance_cat",
  "red_meat", "white_meat", "clothing"
)

df_long <- df |>
  select(all_of(person_vars),
         matches("^(opportunity|motivation|wellbeing|action_status)_\\d+$")) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^(opportunity|motivation|wellbeing|action_status)_\\d+$"),
    names_to = c(".value", "behaviour_id"),
    names_pattern = "^(.*)_(\\d+)$",
    values_drop_na = FALSE
  ) |>
  rename(action_status = action_status) |>
  mutate(
    behaviour_id  = as.integer(behaviour_id),
    action_status = factor(action_status,
                           levels = c("Not relevant", "Relevant, not taken",
                                      "Already taken")),
    behaviour_name = factor(as.character(behaviour_id),
                            levels = names(behaviour_labels),
                            labels = behaviour_labels),
    behaviour_role = case_when(
      behaviour_id %in% c(1, 2, 6)            ~ "Consumer (technology)",
      behaviour_id %in% c(3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9)   ~ "Consumer (curtailment)",
      behaviour_id %in% c(12, 13)             ~ "Organisational participant",
      behaviour_id == 10                      ~ "Investor",
      behaviour_id %in% c(11, 16, 17, 18)     ~ "Citizen",
      behaviour_id %in% c(14, 15)             ~ "Social role model"
    ) |> factor(levels = role_levels),

    is_relevant = as.integer(action_status != "Not relevant"),
    is_taken    = as.integer(action_status == "Already taken"),

    # Expected (not yet taken) or experienced (already taken) quality-of-life
    # impact, centred on the scale midpoint. Expected QoL is standardised later,
    # within the untaken-action analysis population only.
    qol         = wellbeing - 4
  )

# Sanity checks
stopifnot(nrow(df_long) == nrow(df) * 18)
df_long |> count(action_status)
df_long |> count(behaviour_role)

# Perceived opportunity to act and motivation exist only for untaken actions
df_long |>
  group_by(action_status) |>
  summarise(opp_observed = sum(!is.na(opportunity)),
            mot_observed = sum(!is.na(motivation)))
```

# Save

```{r save}
dir.create(here::here("data", "clean"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

saveRDS(df_person, here::here("data", "clean", "data_clean_person.rds"))
saveRDS(df_long,   here::here("data", "clean", "data_clean_long.rds"))

# Constants the analysis script needs
saveRDS(
  list(
    behaviour_labels = behaviour_labels,
    role_levels      = role_levels,
    haul_km          = haul_km,
    flying_cuts      = cuts
  ),
  here::here("data", "clean", "constants.rds")
)
```
